svg.title: Synthetic TIFF calibration before and after export
svg.desc: A source and export with the same synthetic samples declare Z spacing of 1.5 and 3 micrometres. Relative plane centers use a chosen zero, not a measured origin. Reticle inspects metadata, not pixel equality or physical accuracy.

g.text: Recorded relative Z positions · common 0–6 µm scale
Relative zero is illustrative; thumbnails do not depict thickness.
Reticle checks metadata, not pixels or physical calibration.
